title: Native HanLP roles on the retained binomial definition
question: Do canonical or source-aligned diagnostic HanLP inputs supply the roles needed for a source-qualified definition?
method: Authenticate the same frozen source as the retained spaCy comparison. Compare ordinary HanLP syntax and SRL, then a distinct supplied exact punctuation-boundary repair with a canonical same-device control.

inputs.role: Read-only probe over frozen source and native parser profiles

outputs.role: Canonical CUDA inputs, outputs and typed located products
Matched canonical and reviewed-split CPU arms with exact inputs and located products

results.name: Canonical opening n subject recovered
results.note: UD and SRL locate the subject of the integer declaration

results.name: Canonical B declaration includes final parameter
results.note: The final parameter is in its own sentence

results.name: Diagnostic B declaration includes final parameter
results.note: The exact supplied split and sentence join recover UD coordination and the SRL complement

conclusion: Native syntax and SRL provide additional exact local candidates, and a separately identified supplied split recovers the final parameter role. Neither the canonical run nor the diagnostic supplies the released, independently qualified cross-sentence definition witness; the target remains ineligible.
